hooks.text: "Every night they come a little further up the road. Go down and make them start from the bottom again."
"Three of us saw them marching in step past the mounds. Somebody go and break step for them. We'll stand you a drink. One drink."
"Nobody buys lamp oil to go down there any more. Make the Barrows safe enough to be merely dangerous again."
"The Watch can't spare the men. The Watch can spare the coin, this once. Hold them in the Barrows. O. Hale."
"The dead we raise stay raised because someone keeps the others down. This week, let it be you."
"Standing job. Go down, stand your ground, come back up. The Guild pays by the fight, less the Guild's cut."

brief.one: Hold a wave in the Old Barrows
brief.many: Hold {n} waves in the Old Barrows

label: Waves held in the Old Barrows
journal: Go down into the Old Barrows and hold {n} waves against the dead there, in any rooms.
ready: Hand it in at the Lantern Guild's board, inside the Tired Mule in Thornwick.
done: The barrows road was quiet for a night or two.
